text:
You create a character and then
explore an urban area, represented
by a series of “boxes”. You move
from one location to the next with
a combination of choices and dice
rolls. Depending on your mission,
you may be looking for a way to
stop the forces of evil from taking
over the world, or just keep
yourself or some loved ones safe.
Every game you play is a mission.
Multiple connected missions
played by the same character form
a campaign.  You can imagine that
every mission is like an episode of
a TV series, and the campaign is a
whole season.

zh-CN.title: Alone Against Fear · 游戏概览
text: 你要创建一名角色，然后探索一片由一系列“区域格”表示的城区。你通过选择和掷骰，从一个地点移动到另一个地点。根据任务目标，你可能要寻找阻止邪恶势力统治世界的方法，也可能只是要保护自己或亲友。每次游戏都是一项任务。由同一角色连续完成的多项任务构成一场战役。你可以把每项任务想成电视剧的一集，而整场战役则是一季。
